components.name: Stage Primary Action
components.description: Primary stage actions such as starting gameplay or sampler actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7cff6b, #35d0ff); color: #07070d; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 20px; font: 900 15px/1 ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Neutral Control Button
components.description: Base control button used across conductor and modal controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { background: #12121c; color: #f4f4fb; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius: 14px; padding: 11px 9px; font: 900 12px/1 ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #35d0ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact mode/role status chip with accent tint and outline.

narrative.overview: Human Orchestra presents performance state through high-contrast dark panels and vivid accent coding. The system is operational, legible, and energetic. Product direction now requires a retro 16-color/8-bit pixel identity, so future component and layout work should retain current readability while converging on stricter palette discipline and pixel-informed visuals.

rules.name: 16-Color Discipline
rules.body: New UI additions should use only named palette tokens and avoid ad hoc hue additions.

rules.name: Distance Read
rules.body: Primary timing/state labels must remain readable from several feet away on Stage displays.

rules.name: Flat Until Active
rules.body: Depth and glow are state-driven, not ambient decoration.

dos: Do preserve status color semantics when introducing retro styling.
Do prioritize large targets and high contrast for live event operation.
Do evolve ornament and iconography toward pixel-art conventions.
donts: Don't introduce low-contrast pastel themes that reduce readability.
Don't add unconstrained gradients that conflict with 16-color discipline.
Don't make critical mode changes visually subtle.
